artworks.title: Adélaide ... ma bonne ... fais donc ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in a room. On the left, a man is standing holding a crying baby in a blanket. The man appears to be speaking. On the right, a woman is seated at a table, focused on painting a decorative plate. The table is filled with painting supplies. In the background, there are two framed artworks on the wall above a sofa.

artworks.title: Aux Champs-Elysées...De trois a six heures
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals in a social gathering. The drawing depicts people dressed in 19th-century attire. The central figures are depicted in elaborate gowns with multiple layers and ruffles, and everyone is wearing hats. The background includes trees, possibly indicating an outdoor setting. The drawing style emphasizes flowing lines that capture movement and clothing details. The composition and line work focus on fashion and social interactions. The overall atmosphere conveys elegance and lively social engagement.

artworks.title: C'est peut-être bon ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man observing a cart pulled by horses. The man is standing on the left side, looking towards the right at two horses attached to a cart. The cart appears to be empty, and the horses look undernourished. The scene seems to take place on a street or road, with the figures drawn in a simplistic style.

artworks.title: Mr Prudhomme...ce n'est pas moi qui me ferai ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man holding a small dog in an indoor setting with two other figures present. The scene depicts a portly man wearing a tall hat, spectacles, and a suit holding a floppy-eared dog aloft in front of him. To the left, a person leans on a counter. In the background on the right, another figure sits with a second dog by their side, observing the scene. The room has a plain interior, suggested by the presence of a counter and drawers. The artwork uses detailed lines and shading to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: Progrès de l'équitation
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man riding a horse with another horse-drawn carriage in the background. The image shows the man in formal attire riding the horse with precision, while another horse pulls a carriage in the background. The horses are detailed with attention to their muscular structure and the movement of their tails. The background is sketched out and indistinct, highlighting the central action of the piece.

artworks.title: La justice chinoise
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a courtroom scene with multiple figures. Two individuals sit at a table on the left side. In the center, a person stands with raised arms facing the group. To the right of the table, other figures sit closely. The background shows an abstract, pale design suggestive of a crowded room. The setting is formal with marker outlines hinting at architectural elements.

artworks.title: Chinois causant politique
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is an illustration of three figures from the waist up, closely positioned together. The figure on the left has a bald head, a long thin goatee, and is holding a document. The central figure wears a pointed hat and a robe, with a surprised expression. The figure on the right is shown in motion, pulling at a piece of fabric around them. All three figures have exaggerated features in a cartoon style, against a plain background with a pencil or charcoal texture.

artworks.title: En garde national
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two men. The first man is depicted from the waist up, standing upright with his body slightly turned to the side. He has a stern facial expression, an exaggerated nose, and a military-style haircut. He is wearing a dark uniform with a large white belt across his chest. The second man is seated and leaning on a desk, holding a piece of paper in one hand and resting his chin on the other. He has a cartoonish face with a mustache and a cap tilted on his head. His uniform also has decorative shoulder pads. The background of the image has a faint textured pattern with superimposed text at the top and bottom, resembling a newspaper or print setting. On the desk in front of the seated man, there is a sealed ink bottle with a pen in it.

artworks.title: Le chemisier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing from the waist up. The man on the left is slightly bent forward, with a serious expression, pointing towards the other man who is facing the viewer. The first man has a bald head with dark sideburns, a pointed nose, and is dressed in a dark jacket and high-collared shirt. The second man has a round face with curly dark hair and large sideburns. His expression is calm with closed eyes and slightly pursed lips. He is wearing a light-colored shirt with vertical stripes tucked into his pants. The background consists of a sketchy arc shape with faint text in French at the top, against a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: La dame qui cultive les arts
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted from the waist up. The central figure is a seated woman with curly hair and glasses, focused on an artwork she is painting. She holds an artist's palette and brushes. Flanking her are two men, one on each side. The man on the left has a round face, a defined jawline, and short hair styled back, wearing a patterned jacket and high-collared shirt. The man on the right has an angular face with prominent cheekbones and curly hair, dressed in a dark coat over a shirt. The woman is wearing a light-colored dress or smock. Above them, the title "LES BEAUX JOURS DE LA VIE" is printed. The scene is set against a textured or shaded backdrop.

artworks.title: Les courses de chevaux
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a satirical illustration of a horse race with a large crowd of people. Only midsections and heads are visible, and the crowd has exaggerated features. Some individuals have traditional Chinese queue hairstyles, while others wear clothing with intricate designs. The central focus is on a horse rearing up as if about to start running, with a rider on a box-like saddle holding reigns. In the background, there are faintly sketched trees and landforms, suggesting a rural setting. French inscriptions at the top and bottom translate to "VOYAGE EN CHINE" (Journey to China) and "LES COURSES DE CHEVAUX" (Horse Races), respectively.

artworks.title: Les paysagistes. Le premier copie la nature
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a comedic scene with two artists sketching outdoors. Both are seated, one focused on his canvas, the other mimicking his pose. The background features a hill, a tree, and no color. The artwork uses thin pencil strokes to depict details and textures in black and white.

artworks.title: Porter des charges comme ca 'puis six heures ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vineyard harvest scene. It shows two individuals engaged in grape harvesting activities. One person is carrying a basket of grapes on their back, while the other is climbing a ladder with another basket of grapes, appearing to be emptying it into a large vat or barrel. The background includes stylized vegetation, indicating a rural setting.

artworks.title: Faut pas s'plaindre de c'temps-la ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied caricatured figures standing in the rain. The person on the left is depicted with exaggerated facial features, wearing a cap, sleeveless vest, pants, and large shoes, standing with their arms by their sides. The person on the right has large facial features as well, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a long coat, standing with arms crossed. Surrounding them are baskets filled with produce, likely grapes. The background features a dense pattern of lines to indicate rain, with indistinct vegetation and fencing visible.

artworks.title: Un criminel!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two cartoonish characters shown from head to toe. The figure on the left is in a walking position, leading with his right foot and appears to be holding a stick or cane in his left hand. He has exaggerated facial features with large eyes and a prominent nose and is wearing a cap and a loose coat. The other figure is turned slightly towards the first, with a surprised expression on his face, and is reaching out to grab the first character by the collar. He has equally large eyes, a smaller nose, and a small cap on his head, wearing a suit. Both figures are barefoot. In the background, there is a large bush and a tree, with fields or open land extending into the distance. There are no visible items of jewelry on either figure, nor are they holding any objects except for the stick in the first figure’s hand.

artworks.title: Les personnes de l'aimable société qui ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays an audience watching a puppet show. The focus is on a crowd of people visible from the back or side, showing mostly their heads and shoulders. One person prominently in the foreground is partially turned to the side, featuring strong sideburns, noticeable facial features, and wearing a tall top hat with a jacket. The puppet is shown from the waist up, seated above the crowd and centered in the scene, wearing a hat and patterned clothing with a comical expression. The setting appears to be a theater with a curtain as a background.

artworks.title: En délicatesse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two men positioned facing each other. The man on the left is facing the viewer, holding a document against his chest with both hands. He has glasses, distinctive facial features, and styled hair. The man on the right is in profile, facing the first man with a slight smile. Both men are wearing dark robes. In the background, there is minimal detail and some text near the bottom and edge of the image.

artworks.title: Ah! Vous l'êtes ... que voulez-vous que ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men shown from the waist up, engaged in a conversation. The man on the left is positioned slightly turned towards the other man, wearing a robe with a large collar and a cap. He has a distinctive facial features with exaggerated eyes, pronounced chin, curly sideburns, and a classic hairstyle. The other man on the right faces the first man directly, holding a round hat to his chest. His hair is shorter and less styled, and his facial expression is inquisitive or perplexed. The background is plain, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures. The style and expression suggest a caricature, focusing on their facial expressions and body language.

artworks.title: Le garde du commerce
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is standing facing forward, with their hands clenched together at chest height. They have prominent facial features, with a somewhat solemn expression and curly hair peeking out from under a tall top hat. This person is wearing a high-collared shirt or coat. The person on the right is slightly turned away, looking to the left, with a more aged appearance characterized by a receding hairline and a prominent protruding chin, also wearing a top hat and a bow tie with their hands in their coat pockets. The background features a stone wall with the words "PRISON POUR DETTES" inscribed on it.

artworks.title: Ah! Mon cher monsieur, vous m'avez ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men engaged in a handshake. The man on the left wears glasses, a dark suit with a high-collared shirt, and has curly sideburns. The man on the right wears a Roman soldier costume with a helmet and a cape. The background shows plain textured walls, hinting at an indoor space like a backstage or dressing room.

artworks.title: Elle est encore très bien, cette dame ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three people sitting on a bench outdoors. Two elderly men are on the left engaged in conversation. They have exaggerated facial features with prominent noses, chin lines, and wrinkles, wearing top hats and coats. One holds a walking stick while the other clasps his. On the right, a woman with a bonnet and shawl faces away from them. In the background, there is a large tree with branches and leaves.

artworks.title: Moi d'abord sitot que je vois un lièvre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two men and a dog. The men are depicted standing facing each other in conversation. The man on the left gestures with his hands, while the man on the right listens. The man on the left is wearing a cap, a patterned scarf, and a coat with a bag slung by his side. The man on the right wears a hat and a coat, holding a rifle that rests on the ground. Both men have short, unruly hair under their hats. A dog sits between them, facing the man on the right. The background shows a lightly sketched outdoor setting with grass and undefined patches of land, suggesting a rural environment.

artworks.title: Madame ...Nous voici ... au quinze Novembre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a room. The man stands near the window with his hands in his pockets and his mouth open. He has exaggerated facial features, short curly hair, and is wearing a suit. The woman sits in a chair with her body turned towards the man, her eyes closed and head tilted back slightly. She has exaggerated facial features, her hair tucked beneath a bonnet, and is dressed in a gown with a shawl. The room has muted, grayscale tones with a large window showing diagonal lines indicating rain outside, framed by heavy drapes.

artworks.title: Quien! ... Core des parisiens qui veniont s'baigner ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene by a river with swimmers and onlookers. The drawing shows a riverside setting, with figures swimming in the water and others standing on the bank. The characters have exaggerated features and the drawing is in a caricature style. There is a caption underneath indicating dialogue or commentary. The artist uses lines and shading to emphasize expressions and actions. The background includes a tree-lined horizon beyond the river.
